long_description:
Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale.

Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use.

Most teams still rely on onboarding flows, lifecycle emails, support docs, and reactive CSM outreach. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Lumi watches how users actually use your product, spots when they’re ready for the next feature, workflow, or habit, and nudges them at exactly the right moment.
name: Userlens
one_liner: Let agents talk to your customers
